# sonarqube_secured_setting (Resource)

Provides a Sonarqube Secured Setting resource. This can be used to manage Sonarqube secured (encrypted) settings. The value is write-only and cannot be read back from the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_secured_setting" "ldap_bind_password" {
  key   = "ldap.bindPassword"
  value = var.ldap_bind_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Setting key.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Setting value. Stored encrypted server-side and never returned by the API (write-only).

### Optional

- `component` (String) Component (project) key to scope the setting to. If omitted, the setting is global.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
